overview: The proposal adds actual test-owned byte, HTTP, filesystem and SQLite exporters and fixes the native-to-frozen assertion projection. Three evidence-consumer gaps remain: incorrect assertion locators can pass, required case evidence is not fully checked, and Windows mode receipts are not semantically bound to this execution.

R01.evidence: Router lines17-32 keep the full native rosters (8/7/5/7) separate from the frozen parent or three-ID formal projections; lines93-131 require exact expected/observed/selected/passed sets. This is code coverage, not an executed PASS.

R02.evidence: Concrete exporter and runner wiring exist, the three diffs preserve the original business operations, and SQLite columns/scan types match the public DDL. Locator and case-evidence checks below remain incomplete.

R03.evidence: Missing mode inputs now return NOT_RUN; Windows host/branch and file pins are required. Current-run/source-closure/real receipt semantics are not verified, and actual independently produced mode inputs remain absent.

findings.description: _native_exact trusts report.assertion_results without reconstructing the records and pass roster from the pinned Go-test stdout. _owned_exact then checks the named assertion event separately but only checks the claimed owned_export_ref's hash and parent test directory. It does not require that ref to identify the event just validated. C19-01..04 share one owner; changing all four refs to the C19-01 raw file satisfies the shown directory/hash predicates while producing false per-assertion locators.
findings.static_counterexample_not_executed: Keep all named assertion events and native values, replace each C19-02/03/04 report owned_export_ref with the valid C19-01 ref from the same test directory. collect_w09_owned also checks only member/hash/bytes. The router has no comparison of those report refs against the original W09_ASSERTION lines or the event path.
findings.fix: Retain (event_path, parsed_event) while reading exports. Require each assertion's claimed ref to equal the actual assertion-ID event pin, with the exact owner. Reconstruct native W09_ASSERTION records and Go pass events from the pinned stdout and compare their records, evidence and refs to the report. Pin the exact actual invocation as well; do not treat a JSON summary as raw stdout. Validate expected values against the reviewed fixed assertion contract, rather than an arbitrary nonempty expected object in the export.
minimum_controls_NOT_RUN: Legitimate separate pins for all C19 assertions pass
Changed report evidence/ref with unchanged raw stdout rejected

findings.description: The router's required case evidence is weaker than evidence_map.json. C19 validates len(origins)==6 but not two ROOT rows and four DERIVED rows linked to the same original, nor the snapshot/file/body/graph join. A06 requires any HTTP exchange, seven filesystem labels, a before-capture state and the two FTS states; it never requires the exported modified/moved/deleted/revoked permission/root/index/dedupe states or complete API exchanges for the assertions. Missing evidence can therefore be accepted as complete after the remaining member list is rehashed.
static_counterexamples_not_executed: Remove state-a06-revoked and its member row; all required-label/cardinality predicates shown still hold.
Replace six C19 origin rows by six rows with wrong relation/origin/basis bindings while leaving graph counts unchanged; only their count is inspected.
Leave only one valid HTTP exchange; the A06 cardinality check still passes, regardless of missing stale 412/search/context/materialization observations.
findings.fix: Define a finite per-assertion evidence index with exact producer-owner and required event labels, then validate all required refs and their relationships. For C19, join the 27 evidence IDs to the six explicit origin rows, require two ROOT/four DERIVED to the original, and bind seven source-file plus twenty simulated byte pins to actual Artifact/HTTP/graph records; validate the invalidation/chain observations too. For A06, require the seven exported state stages (before-capture, modified, moved, deleted, revoked, indexed, fallback), verify project/principal/root identity/revision/roles/grants/index/dedupe fields, and bind the actual capture/search/412/context/materialization/revoke HTTP records and snapshot hashes to the correct assertion. Hashing the remaining files is not evidence of absent stages.
minimum_controls_NOT_RUN: All genuine exported stages and links accepted
Each required A06 state/HTTP pair removed individually rejected
Changed or unlinked source/simulated raw bytes rejected
Correct indexed versus bounded-scan snapshot/result identities accepted; substituted results rejected

findings.description: The mode decision binds only route, a scope label and this router's hash. producer_id need not exist, and a nonempty reviewer_id is not checked against a bound independent review. For G02, locked_go_sha256 is only truth-tested and host/junction refs are only rehashed: arbitrary or historical files can satisfy those predicates without proving Windows/locked Go/current execution. For FIXTURE, OWNED_TEMP_DIR and IN_PROCESS_HTTptest_RECORDER are likewise accepted as decision strings without an execution-bound review of the actual input/HTTP event set.
findings.static_counterexample_not_executed: On a Windows 11 x64 run with the exported g02-os-branch, use a current-router-hash mode JSON with a missing producer_id, any nonempty reviewer_id, locked_go_sha256='x', and valid pins to unrelated repository files. None of the remaining predicates reads those files as typed host/junction receipts or binds them to this run's report, roots, invocation or source closure.
findings.fix: Specify and consume an actual Root/independent-review mode contract with nonempty distinct producer/reviewer identities and exact reviewed refs, current execution/intent and source-closure bindings. Parse and validate typed Windows host/junction bodies, their execution/host/resource identities and their actual raw observation refs. Match the locked Go hash to the actual invoked executable and locked catalog. Bind FIXTURE classification to the real t.TempDir/input and in-process HTTP evidence, including the old runner scope label. Preserve NULL/absent facts as NOT_RUN; Root must supply real producers before execution qualification. The successful mklink branch at retrieval_test.proposed.go:464 discards CombinedOutput, so retain an owned command/result observation if the selected junction receipt contract needs that raw witness.
minimum_controls_NOT_RUN: Missing producer/reviewer, self-review and unbound review rejected
Arbitrary/history/other-run host or junction files rejected even with correct hashes
Wrong locked-Go hash or invocation rejected
Non-Windows/non-amd64/no actual junction and missing mode remain NOT_RUN
A06 reviewed FIXTURE input origins accepted without claiming GUI/network-listener qualification

suggestions.description: Keep opaque http-request/http-response/file-body payloads out of the JSON event parser entirely. A valid JSON file body is currently placed in events under a file-body label, then lines182-193 incorrectly demand an exists field. The fixed current source bodies are plain text, so this is an unexecuted edge case; add a JSON-body control when adjusting the event reader.

The source_sha256 list omits the new w09_evidence_export_test.go helper and the changed domain_test.go HTTP exporter. Add their final integrated pins, or require the exact Root source-closure manifest containing them, before relying on the exported version manifest. No current source integration or qualification is inferred.

Replace the missing prior_source_basis literal with the actual sealed prior package reference and SHA/bytes. This review did not retry or relocate that unavailable path. Exact Main inverses are independently verified; a whole v2-to-v3 router comparison is not claimed.

what_is_done_well: Real raw bytes are exported before t.TempDir cleanup; OpenFile(O_CREATE|O_EXCL) avoids overwriting export files.
The existing business operations and t.Fatal assertions survive exact full-file inverses for all three Main deltas (1/20/4 hunks).
HTTP Authorization token values are not exported; explicit delivery metadata prevents calling an in-process recorder a network listener.
SQLite grant/index/origin observations are actual queries and cache_identity_claim stays null instead of inventing a cache scalar.
The native/frozen rosters are separated and all six route projections remain PENDING_INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER.
